description: Copy your own time entries from a source date range into a target date range, preserving each entry's weekday offset relative to the source start (e.g. copy last week to this week). New entries are created as Draft. The source range cannot exceed 31 days. Supply source_start_date, source_end_date, and target_start_date (all ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD).

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

source_end_date.description: Inclusive end of the range to copy FROM (YYYY-MM-DD).

source_start_date.description: Inclusive start of the range to copy FROM (YYYY-MM-DD).

target_start_date.description: The first date of the target range (source_start_date maps here, YYYY-MM-DD).

name: copy_period
